Players Committee high-resolution card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/palpatineemperorreturned_ai.png</code> in the PC's Holotable repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/7c6875bd8a1ccc851d821b70ee43fdd7a14c6c44 7c6875b] (1 December 2023, “Alternate Images Dec 2023”), uploaded unchanged. No card-size GIF of this image was committed. Used on the version pages of the card (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026).
